data: In fiscal 2023, Tesla reported total revenue of about $96.77 billion, up roughly 19% from $81.46 billion in fiscal 2022. Gross profit was about $17.66 billion, giving a gross margin of roughly 18.2%, down from about 25.6% in 2022 as price cuts across its vehicle lineup squeezed profitability. Operating income was about $8.89 billion, for an operating margin of roughly 9.2%, compared with about 16.8% in fiscal 2022. These figures come from Tesla's 2023 Form 10-K, and the margins are calculated by dividing gross profit and operating income by total revenue.
